environment.runtime: x64 Windows console in an isolated Windows Server Core LTSC 2022 container
environment.candidate: GNU-target x64 build running on Windows

fixtures.dos: 50 generated lines with CRLF and tabs
fixtures.unix: 50 generated lines with LF and tabs
fixtures.raw: 4096 generated bytes cycling from 00 through FF
fixtures.mixed: Generated CRLF, lone CR and LF, CP437 controls, tabs, and a line longer than 79 cells
fixtures.exact: 79 byte-01 glyphs, CRLF, 158 byte-02 glyphs, CRLF, and ASCII tail

viewport.byte_offset: The title shows the start of the first visible row. Horizontal scrolling shows a separate decimal column.
viewport.caret: No caret appears in the body while viewing.

navigation.vertical: Up and Down move one displayed row. Page Up and Page Down move 23 rows.
navigation.horizontal: Left and Right scroll horizontally only with wrapping off. Home resets the horizontal column.
navigation.wrap: F2 toggles wrapping. A delimiter after an exactly full row is consumed with that row.

line_feed_picker.colors: Cyan panel, double black frame, blue choices, inverse selected row, black shadow two columns right and one row down.
line_feed_picker.null: Each zero byte is a delimiter. CR and LF become CP437 glyphs.

paired_checks.coverage: Startup Text, vertical and horizontal movement, paging, wrap toggling, exact-width rows, and opening, navigating, canceling, and applying the line-feed picker.
paired_checks.remaining: Exact scrollbar fill, translation tables, Unicode document display, encoding-aware editing, and automatic classification outside the tested fixtures.
